description: Use this when the user describes a shoot. Saves a brief, the looks to shoot and the automation they run through, and links it to the board in place of the current one. Nothing runs or is charged: show the user the looks and the credit quote; confirm_brief runs it when they ask. Read the board first with read_shoot_board and follow brief_inputs.guide. If the result lists problems, fix them all and call again. "Run the same" for other clothing: pass from_brief_id (the brief that ran) and the new looks only.

LookInput.description: One look: one outfit worn in the shoot, with who wears it and where.

key.description: update_brief: an existing look's key, to keep that look.

label.description: The look's name, e.g. 'Linen summer set'.

model_id.description: The Model who wears the look.

reference_ids.description: Reference photos (uploaded file ids from the board's References).

OutputInput.description: This brief's output; a field left out is kept, null follows the board's default again.

aspect_ratio.description: e.g. "3:4", "1:1", "9:16": one of the shoot image model's aspect_ratios.

resolution.description: e.g. "1K", "2K", "4K": one of the shoot image model's resolutions (a higher one costs more).

ProposedDirection.description:
The shoot's Direction as the host writes it: its words, a saved art direction, or both; never neither
(``NO_DIRECTION``), so every brief says what runs.

art_direction_id.description: A saved art direction (a library id, or the id save_art_direction returns).

prompt.description: Your words for this shoot, in English, 1-3 sentences. Write one direction for every look from what the user wants (setting, light, mood, poses, purpose). Never name a garment, model, location or look: the same words run on every look. Not needed with an art_direction_id.

RecipeSpec.description: The recipe a demand asks for: its shots and their steps.

image_model.description: A listed image model's slug, only when the user named it.

name.description: What the automation is for, 1-3 words, e.g. 'PDP', 'Lookbook', 'Campaign': Uwear names it with its views and steps ('PDP · front, side, upper').

shots.description: One shot per view, in order.

video_model.description: A listed video model's slug, only when the user named it.

ShotSpec.description: One photo of each look, from one camera.

camera.description: The view, from the camera list.

then.description: Steps on this shot's photo, in order (a video ends the chain).

StepSpec.description: One step on a shot's photo (or on the step before it).

camera_edit_id.description: camera_edit only: the view, one of full_body_front, full_body_back, full_body_side, upper_body_front, upper_body_back, upper_body_side, lower_body_front, lower_body_back, lower_body_side, clothing_detail_front, clothing_detail_back, clothing_detail_side.

kind.description: camera_edit: the same photo from another view (camera_edit_id); edit: a written change (prompt); upscale: a larger photo; video: a clip opening on the photo (prompt: the motion); remove_background: the subject on transparency.

prompt.description: edit: the change; video: the motion (optional).

board_id.description: The open Shoot Board's board_id, from Open Shoot Board or your context.

direction.description: Required unless from_brief_id: what every shot of every look follows, exactly what Generate runs: prompt, art_direction_id (a saved art direction), or both. Write one direction for every look from what the user wants (setting, light, mood, poses, purpose). Never name a garment, model, location or look: the same words run on every look.

from_brief_id.description: "The same" on other clothing: a brief_id that ran. The new brief keeps its automations as they are now, its direction, AI model and output (leave out direction, recipe and recipe_workflow_id); a model_id, location_id or reference_ids left out or empty is that brief's looks' in turn. If the user asked to run it, call confirm_brief in the same turn; otherwise do not.

looks.description: The looks to shoot, each one outfit worn in the shoot, with ids from read_shoot_board.

output.description: The shoot's aspect ratio and resolution, only when the user asked for them; omit to keep the brief's (the user's preferences by default). The brief's output is what runs and is priced; a value the image model does not offer runs at the nearest one it does.

recipe.description: The shots and steps the user described (views, crops, edits, upscale, video): Uwear builds them as a new automation. Not with recipe_workflow_id.

recipe_workflow_id.description: An automation from read_shoot_board's brief_inputs.automations that every look runs through as is (only when it matches what the user asked for). Not with recipe. Omitted while the board pins one (brief_inputs.pinned_automation): every look runs it.

title.description: The shoot's name, only in the user's own words; otherwise leave it out.

name: propose_brief
title: Propose Brief
